First iteration · check the overlay and print scale. Accuracy on real leaves has not been established.

1. Share or print the cutout PDF at Actual size / 100% on A4. Check the 50 mm line with a ruler. Cut out the center circle.

2. Place the leaf flat on a matte white backing, with the marked cutout on top. For yellow or brown leaves, a blue mat can also help. Match the Backing setting.

3. Keep the opening and at least four markers visible. Use even lighting, avoid shadows, and hold the camera nearly overhead.

4. Switch between Camera and Calibration. Both update live. Check the mint selection and adjust the slider. When tracking is lost, the last reading and its circle are retained. Freeze or Save captures that calibrated image. Detached dark rim shadows are excluded; shadows touching tissue may still be counted.

5. Enter the result in cm² as S under LI-6800 Constants → Gas Exchange. The chamber aperture remains set to 6 cm². Keep the measured leaf region registered.

A curved leaf, uneven print, glare, or a badly cut opening can bias the result. This app measures projected area, not the curved surface area.

All processing and saved results stay on your device. Sharing happens only when you choose it. Built with CameraX and OpenCV 4.13 (Apache 2.0).
